mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weather_daily_log (log_date, temperature, precipitation, risk_level, max_temperature, min_temperature, snowfall, alert_summary) VALUES (#{logDate}, #{temperature}, #{precipitation}, #{riskLevel}, #{maxTemperature}, #{minTemperature}, #{snowfall}, #{alertSummary}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE temperature = #{temperature}, precipitation = #{precipitation}, risk_level = #{riskLevel}, max_temperature = #{maxTemperature}, min_temperature = #{minTemperature}, snowfall = #{snowfall}, alert_summary = #{alertSummary}, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT log_date, temperature, precipitation, risk_level, max_temperature, min_temperature, snowfall, alert_summary, memo FROM weather_daily_log WHERE log_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ORDER BY log_date
mapper.update: UPDATE weather_daily_log SET memo = #{memo} WHERE log_date = #{logDate}
